# Carcavelos Forecast – 17 September 2026

**Clean dawn patrol conditions before the wind picks up this afternoon.**

**Morning (best window: 05:00–10:00):** Head out early. Waves are a consistent 1.9–2.0m with light northerly winds under 10km/h. The 7.7s swell is well-organized and Carcavelos will be relatively clean. Water temps around 18–20°C. This is your sweet spot before the crowds and wind arrive.

**Afternoon progression:** Wind ramps from 12km/h at noon to 25km/h by 5pm, creating choppy, onshore conditions by 14:00 onwards. Swell also drops steadily to 1.3–1.4m. Still rideable if you're committed, but quality deteriorates fast.

**Tips:** Go early—don't sleep in. 1.9–2.0m waves suit shortboards today. The morning offers the cleanest faces before the wind chops it up. If you miss dawn, expect crowded, windy slop by afternoon.
